resources.string: Run the recovered X2D II WB calibration primitive through native code
WB primitive only; photographic rendering not connected

This runs a portable reconstruction of one verified firmware routine. Ten outputs are checked against original ARM64 execution, plus four adapter guards. Photo colour, white balance and tone still use Photon. The original vendor library is not loaded in this app.
Fixed to one RAW input frame for this development checkpoint. Photos use the existing Photon renderer.
